WITH city_qualifying AS (
  SELECT 
    c.location AS city,
    COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
total_and_cities AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(qualifying_count) AS total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS num_cities
  FROM city_qualifying
),
city_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cq.city,
    cq.qualifying_count,
    cq.qualifying_count / CAST(tc.total_count AS FLOAT) AS share,
    1.0 / tc.num_cities AS average_share
  FROM city_qualifying cq
  CROSS JOIN total_and_cities tc
)
SELECT 
  city,
  qualifying_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS above_average
FROM city_shares
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY share DESC
